  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, September 13, 2022  5:30 PM  Council Chambers

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Meeting of the City Council, to be called to
order at 5:30 p.m. on Tuesday, September 13, 2022. The agenda for the Special Meeting with the items of
business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below. Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday,
September 8, 2022.

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstatesCA.gov
  and during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Meetings are live broadcast on the City's
  web site and a recording is available for viewing after each meeting.

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS
  This is the appropriate time for members of the public to make comments regarding items not listed on this
  agenda. If you would like to address the City Council, please complete a speaker sheet and give to the
  City Clerk. Under the State's open meeting law - the Brown Act - no action may be taken on any item not
  on the agenda.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 13, 2022

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
by MAYOR ZERUNYAN at 5:30 pm in the Conference Room of City Hall and remotely via
teleconference, in accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361), due to the continuing state
of emergency, including masking and social distancing directives as a result of the threat of
the COVID-19 virus.

2.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Stegura, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  Schmitz

3.  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

None.

4.  NEW BUSINESS

**ADJOURN TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD MEETING**

A.  MEETINGS WITH PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION FUNDRAISING COMMITTEE
  NOMINEES

No action was taken.

** RECONVENE CITY COUNCIL MEETING **

6.  ADJOURNMENT

At 6:50 pm MAYOR ZUCKERMAN adjourned the Special City Council meeting to the regular
City Council meeting on Tuesday, September 13, 2022, at 7:00 pm for the purpose of a
Regular meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Frank V. Zerunyan
City Clerk  Mayor
